definitions.gloss: polite; well-mannered; courteous; proper in etiquette
definitions.explanation: Describes a person who follows social etiquette properly and behaves with good manners. A compound i-adjective from 礼儀 (etiquette) + 正しい (correct, proper).

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はとても{礼儀正|れいぎただ}しい。
{礼儀正|れいぎただ}しい{態度|たいど}で{接客|せっきゃく}する。
examples.english: To serve customers with courteous manners.

examples.japanese: {日本人|にほんじん}は{礼儀正|れいぎただ}しいと{海外|かいがい}から{評価|ひょうか}されることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Japanese people are often praised overseas for being well-mannered.

notes:
USAGE:
{礼儀正|れいぎただ}しい is a compound i-adjective describing someone who follows proper etiquette. It can modify nouns or be used predicatively.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {礼儀正|れいぎただ}しい{人|ひと} (a polite person)
- {礼儀正|れいぎただ}しい{態度|たいど} (courteous attitude)
- {礼儀正|れいぎただ}しく{挨拶|あいさつ}する (to greet politely)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{丁寧|ていねい}な means polite or careful, but focuses more on carefulness and thoroughness in actions and speech. {行儀|ぎょうぎ}がいい means well-behaved and focuses more on physical conduct.
